title: Mixed Event — Happy Lovely Everyday!

meta.Outline: MORE MORE JUMP! are delighted to receive a request to perform at an elementary school. With experience performing in children's variety shows under her belt, Airi enthusiastically starts planning for the event.

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We got a performance request?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: S-Someone wants to see us do a show?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. I just found a message in our mailbox asking us to do just that.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Our mailbox...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You know, the email account we made when we decided to form MORE MORE JUMP! It's an account just for our group's business.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And somebody just sent us this request.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Our own email account...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We'll need a portal for contacting us about possible job opportunities as well.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. If someone wants to get in touch with us and doesn't know how, they might just call the school or something.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It'd be nice to have a phone dedicated to this, but we'll have to make do with just an email address for now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whoa! It's really starting to feel like we're actually idols!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. We'll have to work hard to make sure that phone gets lots of calls.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, we did make an account!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Don't tell me you'd forgotten about it until now?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
N-No, I didn't!
I'm just really surprised by how quickly this request came...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. I understand how you feel, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We're still only just getting started as a group, so I wasn't really expecting to receive anything like this so soon.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm just as surprised as you are.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The joint stream we did with Hayakawa helped grow our subscriber base, but it must've had a bigger effect than we realized.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, that was definitely a huge break for us!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But at the same time, the new segments we've been doing in our videos have been pulling their weight too, right?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Everybody watching always seems to really love the ideas Haruka and Minori come up with.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Minori has a talent for seeing things from our fans' perspectives.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe... At first, my ideas were pretty much all just things I personally wanted to see... But I'm glad everybody likes what we're doing.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Look, Minori, you've been working hard every single day since we started and got results, so have a little more confidence in yourself!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So what does this request entail...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Apparently, it came from a group of elementary school students from the suburbs, and they want to put on a graduation event a little earlier than usual.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Graduation? Now?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. It says that their school is about to be closed down.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It is?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. Enrollment for this school has been going down and it currently only has around thirty students. The ones remaining are going to be sent to other schools it seems.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Normally, students would graduate in March, but the school itself is also showing signs of dilapidation so...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They're having a Farewell Party for the school after they come back from their summer vacations.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That was also apparently when one student asked for us to be there, as MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That means... They want us to perform there and provide them with one last memory of their elementary school.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's so sad... Their school's just going to disappear...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm not sure what I'd do if a school I went to just vanished one day...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I wouldn't know what to do either. Not being able to see your friends would be terrible too...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
That'd be awful...
Being scattered to the winds like this...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's it! We're doing this!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Eep!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We should feel honored that they invited us to perform at such an important event!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Their school will be gone, but we have to make it so they can smile one last time and have the courage to move forward as the world around them changes...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We have to do everything we can for them as idols!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I agree completely.
I'd like for us to accept this request and perform as MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, me too!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'd like that as well!
I'm looking forward to it already.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Great. I'll send them our response now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, also...
This school even gave us permission to livestream this event.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, really?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. It'll be an important log of what happened for the students, but they also seem to want us to benefit from it as well.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I see...
That's very thoughtful of them.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That means we should try to give these children as much hope as we can in return!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, and...!
Why don't we do something else on top of a show?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Something else?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! We're performing for elementary schoolers this time, so I thought it'd be nice if we could play and have fun with them!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right. If we think of it as a full event, we'd be able to expand upon what we've been doing online...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We'll have to discuss details with the school, but I think it's definitely worth asking them.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I agree as well! I would love to do something with the children!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
But what should we do with them?
I don't have much experience with events involving children, so I'm not sure which activities would be best...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I don't have much experience with those kinds of events either...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Right. I've been a part of a few, but...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I know! I have an idea!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, Minori, let's hear it!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Since everyone's saying goodbye to the school and each other, wouldn't they all want to make it a really special moment?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's why I want to make a yearbook with them!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: A yearbook? That could be fun...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, hold on. It says that the school's already working on one...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I see. If we are going to make one, it'd be nice for ours to be distinct from the official version...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
And cost is gonna be an issue too.
Physical books won't be cheap.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Right...
I didn't think about it like that...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's okay, Minori. This idea might not pan out, but we should still try to come up with more.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I agree. We can't let ourselves be limited by what's possible or not possible.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, so let's keep brainstorming!

rows.Speaker: Minori & Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes, I like it.
Let's wrap things up and...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? It's already time to go?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right.
We must've been talking for quite some time.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But we got some great ideas, so why don't we call it a day?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Okay.
This is probably a good place to stop. Although, we don't have much time left to work with on this...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I didn't know planning an event like this would be so hard...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I know, right...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (But I really do like the ideas we came up with and it feels like we're just one step away from having something solid to work with.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (All that remains is...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Yeah! If we do it like that show I used to be on, we might be able to include all of our ideas!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, would it be okay if I finish summing up all our ideas?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Okay, but are you sure?
We know you're busy and...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'll be fine! I came up with an idea for the whole thing, so it'll only take me a second!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I don't see why not.
I'm sure she'll deliver for us.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then, if you don't mind...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You got it!
I'll have something for you all tomorrow, so stay tuned until then!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay! Thanks, Airi!
Airi's Room

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Okay...
I'm making good progress.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This was definitely the right way to go! The ideas everyone came up with are fitting in perfectly too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: All that time I spent on variety shows meant for kids is really paying off. Morning Kids Station probably taught me the most about that world.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Everything I did, everything I went through... None of it was a waste.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright...!
Let's keep this up!! Here comes Lovely Airi!!
The next day
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I compiled everything we talked about yesterday into one file, so if you don't mind taking a look...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whoa... This is so easy to follow!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You did this all in one night? The formatting looks so professional...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. You never cease to amaze us, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku, stop staring at me and look at the doc I just gave you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, I've divided this event into three major parts...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: The first involves Minori's idea: “Let's Make A Yearbook!”

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yay! We get to use my idea!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Good for you, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, focus! Check the fine print...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We're gonna need each student to send us their favorite picture from their time at this school, which we'll use to put together a special yearbook.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We'll take a group picture with everybody and throw it in at the very end!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That sounds lovely♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Okay, that sounds good.
Do you have a budget worked out for this? Like you said, making physical yearbooks won't be cheap.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We'll have to discuss that with the school, but I was thinking about making it a digital yearbook. That way, we can cut costs dramatically.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I see...
That definitely would be more affordable.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But if we do have the budget to publish them, why not have one printed just for the principal...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Since the students will receive their diplomas from the principal, they could give back by handing the principal this, no?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That's a great idea, Shizuku!
I love it!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I have to think that the principal would love it too! I'd probably cry if my students did that for me...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, let's see what the school thinks!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Now, our next segment is... “Let's Play With MORE MORE JUMP!”

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We'll split up into four teams, one for each of us, and play games and stuff...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, that sounds fun!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The games are in this doc, but they include tag, a true or false quiz and...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Since we'll be limited on time, I want to have games that everyone knows, ones that are simple, easy to learn and easy to tweak.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, like giving someone more points for catching a sixth-grader during tag...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The quiz could include questions that have to do with the school too! The more you know about it, the better!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, wouldn't it be a great opportunity for us to learn all about a school we've never been to before?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see. Not only that, the students that like to learn will do well during the quiz, while the more athletic students can have fun during tag.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Exactly. Remember how you wanted everyone to have fun during the Sports Festival, Haruka? I want to do the same for these kids and their school.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
And last but not least, we'll have our finale: “It's Showtime!”
The kids will all get a chance to have fun while they watch our performance!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Right, this is good.
I'm sure everyone else will like it too.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
You're so amazing, Ms. Airi!
I still can't believe you came up with this in one night...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh? Ms. Airi?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But you really are amazing, Airi, and we genuinely believe that.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You're both exaggerating.
These ideas are all based on your guys' ideas anyway.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
No, that's not the whole story.
You clearly made sure to consider how the students would feel about each of these activities.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I think you were able to polish it up this much because you truly care about our fans, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Y-You... Think so?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Of course! There's so much that I can still learn from you, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Again, you're exaggerating...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Still, I appreciate it. Also, how would you guys feel about seeing what Miku and the others think about this?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Sure, why not?
They might even give us ideas that we never would've thought of.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Shall we head over then?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!!
bgm_area00002
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright, we're here.
Oh, there aren't any shows happening right now. I wonder where Miku and the others are...
No, it'll look cuter if we jump out from the center of the stage!
I'm not saying that your idea is bad or anything, but I just think it'd be better for us to start from the sides and join in the middle.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hm? There's a boy here...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, could it be...?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I think they're over there somewhere. Let's go take a look.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We'll run up from the sides while high-fiving everyone, meet in the middle and finish in this pose.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Wouldn't it look a lot cooler if we did that? In a way, we'd be reuniting.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Grrr... It makes too much sense...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Aha! I knew it! It's Len!!
Rin's here too! Hi!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, Minori!
Welcome!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Minori...?
That means you're the girls who made this SEKAI. Rin's told me all about you.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It's nice to finally meet you. My name is Kagamine Len, and I'm looking forward to working with you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: H-His idol aura is so strong...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: He has such a sparkling smile too. He's just like a knight in shining armor on his valiant steed.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm not sure about the steed part, but I'm sure he works hard every day to maintain his image as an idol.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Every day... He seems so amazing already...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Nice to meet you, Len!
By the way, what were you guys doing just now?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, Rin and I are gonna put on a show, and were just going over what we'll be doing.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You're doing a show together?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: A show with the two of you sounds like so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We're still figuring out what to do about our setlist and choreography, so I need to keep coming up with more ideas!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, if you need ideas, we can come up with some!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Right.
If you like, we'd be more than happy to help.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Really?
That'd be a huge help.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You got it!
Haruka's a pro when it comes to direction and choreography, and Shizuku has a knack for knowing how to strike the perfect pose...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori has a talent for knowing what the fans want to see too, so I'm sure we'll be able to come up with some good stuff!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It's like you each have your own specializations♪

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
That's pretty cool.
Oh, Airi, what are you good at?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Me?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
What am I good at...?
Compared to others, I'm...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Better at being the MC than most?
I think I just like making everyone smile by chatting with them.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That is true. Airi really knows how to manage a crowd and create a good mood for them.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Cool. If we have any questions about MCing, we'll ask you, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sure! Anytime!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Airi's also really really good at organizing events and coming up with ideas for them...! Wait, no...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I almost forgot! We came here to ask you guys about this elementary school event we'll be doing!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right.
We'd like to ask you two about it once we're done discussing your event...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You're doing an event too?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. We've been asked to participate in an event an elementary school will be hosting. We have a summary of what we'll be doing and wanted you guys to see it too.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But would it be too much for you two since you're busy with your own event?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
No, don't worry about that.
I'm sure both our events will go better if we all work together on them.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! I wanna help too♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But you said it's gonna be at an elementary school. How does that work?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright, then let's get right to it!
The school that contacted us about this is actually about to be closed down...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Whew... We really chatted up a storm!

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I'm glad that Rin and Len were able to give us so many new ideas.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, asking them was a great idea!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright, I'll append the document Airi made to include the ideas Rin and Len gave us, and send it over to the school right away.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hm? There's something here from them...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: There is?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. They're thanking us for agreeing to participate in this event.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh... They even included some messages from the students.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
From the students?
What did they say?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
<I can't wait to meet MMJ!>
<I can't believe THE Shizuku Hinomori is coming to our school!>
Hehe. They seem very excited.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-Is there anything about me...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: For you? Let's see...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I guess I'm getting ahead of myself...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, here's one.
<I can't wait to meet you, Minori!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: R-Really?! I don't know what to say!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: There are quite a few here for Airi too...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
For me?
Mind if I take a look?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sure. It's all yours.

rows.Speaker: Email
rows.Line: <To Airi!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Hehe. They really went out of their way to write this for me. I couldn't be happier.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Let's see what they said...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh...
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Email
rows.Line: <To Airi!>

rows.Speaker: Email
rows.Line: <I always loved seeing you on your seven o'clock show, The Wide World of Laughs!>

rows.Speaker: Email
rows.Line: <My favorite part was when you dressed up as The Masked Variety Idol, Happy Everyday.>

rows.Speaker: Email
rows.Line: <The way you fought against really strong people and fell into all those mud traps was the best! I can't believe I get to meet the real Happy Everyday!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hm?
Is something wrong, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh? W-Why do you ask?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You seemed very concerned just now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Are you sure you're okay?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I-I'm fine, honest... I was probably just too focused on reading these messages!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But isn't it so nice to hear from our fans like this? What do you think, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I think so too! It gives me hope for tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Which is why we need to turn these messages into our fuel as idols...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Is Airi really okay?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (What was written in that message? Let's see, the ones for Airi...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Um, Shizuku...
Mind if we have a quick conference?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Sure. How can I help you, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It's about Airi. There's something I'd like you to do for her.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: About Airi?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. Take a look at this message to her...
After practice
Miyamasuzaka

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We broke a pretty good sweat during practice, huh? Event planning is fun and all, but nothing really beats a good workout!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I agree.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Um, Airi...
There's something I need to ask you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hm? Sure. What's up?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Haruka and I had another look at the messages the students from that school sent us.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: And we came across one student who seemed very interested in when you were on all those variety shows...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You felt concerned after reading this, right...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We were wondering if that message dredged up some unpleasant memories...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's all ancient history...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sure, I had a tough time and went through a lot, but I thought it gave me a good experience!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And for the sake of those kids, I'm gonna do everything I can for this event.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, I'll see you tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: A-Airi...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hello, Haruka...
Yes... I spoke with her just now. She said that she's fine and...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku

rows.Line: You really know how to inspire hope in all of us!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Thanks, Shizuku...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And I'm gonna keep spreading hope left and right from here on out!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Spread hope left and right?
Something about that feels a bit off...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Still, I'm just glad you feel better now.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah!
And this event was so much fun even though it was our very first one!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It'd be great to do something like this again...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It'd be great? No, Minori, we're gonna do something like this again for sure!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I want to keep doing more stuff for my fans! A lot more!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And we're gonna keep trying more and more tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Minori, Haruka & Shizuku
rows.Line: Yeah!
